title: Invoice from an approved quotation
summary: An invoice made from a quotation you have already approved, left as a draft for you to approve.
text: Make an invoice from the quotation in [earlier], dated [date]. The quotation must already be approved: if it is not, stop and tell me so, and make no invoice. Copy its customer, lines and prices exactly. Leave the invoice as a draft for me to approve; do not send it to anyone. Then write a short read-back of what the invoice says.
